sentences.text: -------Non-applicant
For Applicant : Mr. Ashutosh Biswas, Advocate.

For State : Ms. Avelin Juneja Gambhir, Panel Lawyer  Hon'ble Shri Parth Prateem Sahu, Judge  ORDER ON BOARD  (16 / 04 /202 4)
1.

Applicant has filed this first bail application under Section 439 of CrPC for grant of regular bail as he has been arrested in connection with Crime No. 300/2023 registered at Police Station - Dharamjaigarh, District Raigarh, (C.G.) for offence punishable under Sections 363, 366A, 376,
376(2)(n), 376(3), 34 of IPC and Section 4, 5(L) & 6 of the POCSO Act.
2.
Case of prosecution in brief is that father of victim lodged a report in the concerned police station stating that his daughter is found missing from the house.
Based on the report, initially offence under Section 363 of IPC was registered.

During course of investigation, victim was recovered from possession of applicant and after recording her statement under Section 161 of CrPC, other offence were also added and applicant was arrested on 30.10.2023.
3. Learned counsel for applicant submits that applicant has been falsely implicated in the crime, he has not committed any offence as such.

The other co-accused Sanjay Madhu has been enlarged on bail in MCRC No. 8978/2023 on 16.01.2024 and the case of applicant is also stand on similar footing, hence, applicant may be enlarged on regular bail.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned State counsel opposes the submission of learned counsel for applicant and submits that the case of co-accused Sanjay Madhu is different than that of applicant as there is no allegation against him of committing sexual intercourse with victim.
Allegation against applicant is of committing sexual intercourse with girl less than 16 years of age.
On the date of incident, victim was only 15 years of age.
5. I have heard learned counsel for the parties.
6. Taking into consideration, facts and circumstances of the case, nature of allegation, age of victim on the date of incident, I do not find present to be a fit case to allow this application.
7. Accordingly, this application filed under Section 439 of CrPC is hereby rejected.

Sd/-
